notes.title: The update of v1.1
notes.content:
The update reads as follows:
1. Add a new function of language switching which currently only supports switching between Chinese and English.
2. Perform optimizations to some paticular details based on the users' feedback.
3, Change the game icon and mask.
4, Develop the new smooth movement mode which is successfully compatible with the updated version of system and can meet the needs of users.The previour version of system just supports the operation of teleport mode and automatically blocks the operation of smooth movement mode that easily makes users feel  vertiginous.
